In production, it has three dairy companies, Kyushu Nyugyo, Koonyusha and Ibaraki Nyugyo, and seasoning and alcoholic beverage manufacturers including Morita; in distribution, it sells imported foods through Arukan Co., Ltd. and, under Atariya Foods Limited, has a food wholesale structure that extends sales channels across Europe; and in sales, it develops franchises of its in-house developed formats. It aims to improve productivity and profitability by deepening its integrated production and sales model.
